generate_cs_bindings: generate C# bindings for MuJoCo from introspect modules via CLI with --header_file_list flag
parse_constants_from_headers: parse #define constants from MuJoCo C header files into a Python dictionary
write_enums: write C# enum declarations for MuJoCo introspected enum types to output
write_structs: write C# struct declarations with StructLayout for MuJoCo introspected structs to output
write_functions: write C# DllImport function declarations for MuJoCo introspected C functions to output
